items.author: asmrtfm
items.body:
It’s a bit concerning that “do not”, “don’t”, “never”, and similar negations don’t appear to be treated as off-limits. Since these tokens invert the meaning of the sentence they appear in, that seems like an important gap.

For this to be acceptable in production environments negation handling would need to be preserved reliably.

Forgive me if this isn’t the right place to propose a convention—I’m not sure where else people would see the issue. One potential generalizable solution could be to preserve ALL CAPS tokens, which may help prevent over-compression into whatever the system defines as
items.title: proposal/preserve-negating-words
